def runs(p, text, size=None):
    parts = re.split(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*|__.+?__)", text)
    for part in parts:
        if not part: continue
        if part.startswith("**"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold = True
        elif part.startswith("__"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.italic = True
        else:
            r = p.add_run(part)
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    return p

def P(text="", align=None, indent=None, first=None, size=None, after=None, keep=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    runs(p, text, size)
    if align == "c": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    elif align == "j": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    elif align == "r": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
    if indent is not None: p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    if first is not None: p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(first)
    if after is not None: p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)

from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn

doc = Document()

def runs(p, text, size=None):
    parts = re.split(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*|__.+?__)", text)
    for part in parts:
        if not part: continue
        if part.startswith("**"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold = True
        elif part.startswith("__"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.italic = True
        else:
            r = p.add_run(part)
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    return p

def P(text="", align=None, indent=None, first=None, size=None, after=None, keep=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    runs(p, text, size)
    if align == "c": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    elif align == "j": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    elif align == "r": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
    if indent is not None: p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    if first is not None: p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(first)
    if after is not None: p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    if keep: p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
    return p

def B(text, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level==0 else "List Bullet 2")
    runs(p, text); return p

def N(text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number"); runs(p, text); return p

def H(text, lvl=1):
    return doc.add_heading(text, level=lvl)

def R(text):
    # resolution paragraph: justified, first-line indent
    return P(text, align="j", first=0.5)

def RH(text):
    p = P("**" + text + "**", keep=True); p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(8); return p

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); sh = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    sh.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); sh.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); sh.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor); tcPr.append(sh)

def table(headers, rows, widths):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers)); t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""; runs(c.paragraphs[0], "**"+h+"**", 9.5); shade(c, "D9D9D9")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i,val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            chunks = val.split("\n")
            runs(cells[i].paragraphs[0], chunks[0], 9.5)
            for ch in chunks[1:]:
                runs(cells[i].add_paragraph(), ch, 9.5)
    for row in t.rows:
        for i,w in enumerate(widths):
            row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph()
    return t

def pagebreak():
    doc.add_paragraph().add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

R("I understand the preference for a single, comprehensive document. I do not recommend placing items 3 through 13 of the Instructions in the incorporator action, for the following reasons:")
B("**Limited statutory authority.** Where, as here, the Certificate does not name initial directors (Certificate, Article V and Article VI), Section 107 of the DGCL authorizes the incorporator, “until the directors are elected,” to manage the affairs of the corporation and do what is necessary and proper to perform its organization, including adopting the original bylaws and electing directors. Once the incorporator elects the directors, that authority ends. The remaining items are board matters under the DGCL and the Company’s own documents: election of officers (DGCL § 142; Bylaws TOC § 4.2); issuance of stock and determination of consideration (DGCL §§ 152, 153; Certificate § 6.1); adoption of an equity plan and reservation of shares (DGCL § 157; Term Sheet § 3.3 expressly makes the Plan “subject to the approval of the Board of Directors”); indemnification agreements “in the form to be approved by the Board” (Instructions item 9; Bylaws TOC § 6.5); and the SAFE financing (Term Sheet § 12 contemplates “approval by the respective governing bodies”).")
B("**Diligence risk.** Tideline has asked to see clean formation documents before countersigning. Founder stock, the option pool, and the SAFEs approved only by an incorporator are a common diligence finding that would require a ratifying board consent (and possibly a DGCL § 204 ratification for the stock issuance) — the opposite of a clean record.")
B("**Same practical result.** Attachment 2 is a fully drafted unanimous written consent of the two directors under DGCL § 141(f) covering every remaining item on your list. It can be signed by Dr. Nakamura and Ms. Chandrasekaran on January 14, 2025, effective immediately after your action, so nothing is lost by splitting the documents. If the founders cannot sign today, the January 21, 2025 fallback date you mentioned also works (see the timing note in Part 4).")

content.text:
I've drafted the incorporator action as you asked, plus a cover memo, but I limited it to the steps an incorporator can legally take, so it covers only some of your 13 items. Under Delaware law (DGCL § 107) an incorporator's authority ends once the directors are elected. That includes electing officers, issuing founder stock, adopting the option plan and approving the SAFEs, so I put items 3–13 in a companion consent of the two new directors. Dr. Nakamura and Ms. Chandrasekaran can sign it on January 14, effective right after your action. The file is one .docx: memo, your action with a placeholder for the bylaws as Exhibit A, then the directors' consent. The par value is $0.00001 everywhere; $0.0001 appears only where the memo quotes the term sheet. The file passes the validation script and reads back correctly.

The memo's discrepancy table also flags these points:
- **Par value:** the term sheet says $0.0001, ten times the filed certificate's $0.00001. Tideline should confirm in writing that the certificate as filed is acceptable.
- **SAFE amount:** your $4M with angels conflicts with the term sheet, which is $3.5M with Tideline as the only investor. Its exclusivity clause through February 15 is binding and the founders signed it personally, so approaching angels now would breach it. The directors' consent authorizes $3.5M, with a bracketed version for up to $4M that applies only if Tideline consents in writing.
- **Option pool:** 1,500,000 shares is about 16.7% of the fully-diluted shares before the SAFEs, or 12.8% after they convert. The term sheet caps the pool at 10%, which is about 833,333 or 1,125,000 shares depending on whether you count the SAFEs. I left 1,500,000 in brackets with a drafting note.
- **Other gaps:**
  - The term sheet requires standard investor protections in the certificate, and it has none.
  - The Company didn't exist when the term sheet was signed, so the directors' consent adopts its binding clauses on the Company's behalf.
  - Your email's timestamp is earlier than the 9:00 AM filing stamp; please confirm the filing time before you sign.
  - I only had the bylaws table of contents, not the full text. Before it goes in as Exhibit A, check the sections the memo lists (the number of directors in § 3.2, among others) against the certificate.

The 83(b) deadline runs from the date each founder buys the shares: February 13 if the stock is issued January 14, or February 20 if issued January 21.
